# H1 2026 close: CFO board brief

Source: finance/ledger.csv (86 entries, all mapped to finance/chart_of_accounts.csv), finance/cash_balance.txt, finance/README.md. Currency BRL.

## Monthly P&L (BRL)

| Month | Revenue | COGS | Gross profit | GM % | S&M | R&D | G&A | EBITDA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-01 | 200,510.87 | -60,091.92 | 140,418.95 | 70.03 | -143,475.23 | -163,396.33 | -43,826.35 | -210,278.96 |
| 2026-02 | 216,328.06 | -64,278.71 | 152,049.35 | 70.29 | -138,161.28 | -182,271.02 | -43,917.13 | -212,300.08 |
| 2026-03 | 219,066.17 | -69,096.05 | 149,970.12 | 68.46 | -135,519.34 | -171,742.87 | -47,233.36 | -204,525.45 |
| 2026-04 | 238,163.26 | -70,867.73 | 167,295.53 | 70.24 | -139,688.11 | -179,804.44 | -44,753.63 | -196,950.65 |
| 2026-05 | 243,032.89 | -73,973.13 | 169,059.76 | 69.56 | -138,680.10 | -185,905.30 | -46,420.18 | -201,945.82 |
| 2026-06 | 272,391.57 | -75,162.69 | 197,228.88 | 72.41 | -151,896.54 | -189,990.01 | -48,310.55 | -192,968.22 |

H1 totals: revenue 1,389,492.82; EBITDA -1,218,969.18.

## How each month went
- Jan: baseline. Revenue 200.5k, GM 70.0%, EBITDA -210.3k.
- Feb: revenue +7.9% MoM; R&D step-up (+18.9k) kept EBITDA flat at -212.3k, the worst month of H1.
- Mar: revenue +1.3% only; Kestrel refund (-6.8k) and higher cloud cost pulled GM to 68.5%, the H1 low. EBITDA improved to -204.5k on lower opex.
- Apr: revenue +8.7%; GM back to 70.2%; EBITDA -197.0k.
- May: revenue +2.0%; second Kestrel refund (-8.6k) trimmed GM to 69.6%; EBITDA -201.9k (R&D at H1 high to date).
- Jun: best month. Revenue +12.1% to 272.4k, GM 72.4% (H1 high), EBITDA -193.0k (H1 best) despite S&M +13.2k.

Trend: revenue +35.8% Jan to Jun; EBITDA loss narrowed 8.2%; opex grew slower than revenue. Watch item: Kestrel refunds in two of six months (15.4k total).

## Burn and runway (board definition, finance/README.md)
- Burn = average negative EBITDA of Apr, May, Jun = (196,950.65 + 201,945.82 + 192,968.22) / 3 = 197,288.23 per month.
- Cash at 30/06/2026 = 1,847,350.40.
- Runway = 1,847,350.40 / 197,288.23 = 9.36 months (cash out around mid-April 2027 at current burn).
- Cross-check: cash fell 461,837.60 in June vs EBITDA -192,968.22 plus financial income 5,621.65. The gap (~268.9k) is not explained by the P&L ledger (likely capex, working capital, debt or tax outflows not in this ledger). Flag to investors; if June cash movement is the true run-rate, runway is ~4 months.

## Assumptions
- EBITDA excludes the financial line (investment income, interest and IOF); it is treated as below EBITDA.
- Refunds (3.1.09) net against revenue; gross margin = (revenue + COGS) / revenue.
- Burn follows the board definition exactly, not the cash-flow change.
- No depreciation or tax entries exist in the ledger, so EBITDA equals operating result.
